stay.name: Bistrotel ‘t Amsterdammertje

packages.name: World Trip inclusief overnachting en transfer (5 courses)
packages.includes: A night for two at Bistrotel ‘t Amsterdammertje with breakfast, the 5-course World Trip menu with matching wines for two at the restaurant, and taxi transfer there and back (6 courses EUR 664, 7 courses EUR 704 for two)
packages.when: Not available Friday and Saturday for the 5-course version; subject to room availability; tourist tax of EUR 3.60 per person per night and EUR 5 parking per room extra

packages.name: Triple XXX Arrangement
packages.includes: The 7-course World Trip menu with matching wines, water and coffee, transfer, and a free night at the Bistrotel (breakfast and tourist tax extra)
packages.when: Sundays only, limited availability, not on public holidays; book by email

packages.name: Sterren aan de Vecht
packages.includes: Two nights over three days: one at Bistrotel ‘t Amsterdammertje with a 6-course all-in dinner at the restaurant and transfer, one at Hotel de Nederlanden in Vreeland with a 6-course all-in dinner there, breakfasts and bicycles
packages.when: Subject to availability; tourist tax of EUR 3.60 per person per night and EUR 5 parking per room extra

stay.note: Its rooms are at the owner’s own Bistrotel ’t Amsterdammertje in Nieuwersluis, a few kilometres away; the packages include a taxi there and back.
